name: SERGIO
simulation_summary: Simulates single-cell gene expression from a user-provided gene regulatory network using stochastic differential equations, with steady-state multi-cell-type and differentiation modes plus optional technical-noise modules.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper passes this SERGIO-format comma-separated target interaction file to sergio.build_graph(input_file_taregts=...) when input_preset=custom_files.
Wrapper passes this SERGIO-format comma-separated master-regulator rate file to sergio.build_graph(input_file_regs=...) when input_preset=custom_files.
Wrapper reads this square migration-rate matrix and passes it as bifurcation_matrix when input_preset=custom_files and simulation_mode=differentiation.
conditional_required.message: sergio_bifurcation_matrix is required when input_preset=custom_files and simulation_mode=differentiation.

compatibility_rules.message: scrna_grouped requires number_bins >= 2 so public groups and group truth contexts are meaningful.
input_preset=demo_steady_state must be run with simulation_mode=steady_state.
input_preset=demo_differentiation must be run with simulation_mode=differentiation.
input_preset=demo_steady_state requires number_genes=100 to match the bundled SERGIO demo files.
input_preset=demo_steady_state requires number_bins=9 to match the bundled SERGIO demo files.
input_preset=demo_differentiation requires number_genes=100 to match the bundled SERGIO demo files.
input_preset=demo_differentiation requires number_bins=3 to match the bundled SERGIO demo files.
lineage_tree requires simulation_mode=differentiation because SERGIO only uses a bifurcation graph in dynamics mode.

threading.upstream_mapping: SERGIO a6190b74425112834c8fa9b4b6157d9cb3d1ab88 exposes no public thread, worker or core-count control; ANDREA must assign threads=1 and the wrapper must not expose threading as a simulator parameter.

upstream_configuration: Wrapper calls sergio(..., dynamics=False) and sim.simulate() when simulation_mode=steady_state, or sergio(..., dynamics=True, bifurcation_matrix=...) and sim.simulate_dynamics() when simulation_mode=differentiation.
Wrapper calls sim.build_graph(input_file_taregts=..., input_file_regs=..., shared_coop_state=...) before simulation; the target interaction file is the fixed GRN that drives expression.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper parses the same SERGIO target interaction rows passed to build_graph and writes one non-self-loop regulator-target row per signed K value as context=global in truth/networks.csv.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is abs(K), where K is SERGIO's signed maximum interaction strength; public sign is '+' for K>0 and '-' for K<0.
limitations: SERGIO does not emit a separate canonical truth file; the public global truth is normalized from the native simulator GRN input/state used to run the simulation.
Hill coefficients and half-response values affect simulation dynamics but are not represented as separate columns in the public truth edge table.

truth_contexts.explanation: The global profile does not export group truth contexts.
SERGIO uses one fixed GRN and does not expose cell-specific regulatory networks.

Unspliced transcript expression returned by getExpressions_dynamics() when dynamics=True.
Spliced transcript expression returned by getExpressions_dynamics() when dynamics=True.

Binary dropout mask returned by SERGIO dropout_indicator or dropout_indicator_dynamics.
UMI/count matrix returned by convert_to_UMIcounts or convert_to_UMIcounts_dynamics.

derivations.method: Export every public gene identifier present in expression.tsv as extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The simulated expression gene set is the appropriate enrichment background for downstream analyses of the generated dataset.
limitations: The background is dataset-derived and synthetic, not an organism-specific external annotation universe.

derivations.method: Normalize every SERGIO target interaction K value into a regulator-target prior edge using score=abs(K), public sign '+' for K>0 and public sign '-' for K<0, after applying the same public gene-id mapping used for truth/networks.csv.
assumptions: The SERGIO input GRN is an oracle regulatory prior when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is a truth-derived oracle prior rather than an independently noisy prior.

derivations.method: Export the union of all regulator IDs in the target interaction file and all master-regulator IDs in the master-regulator rate file, mapped to public gene identifiers, one per line.
assumptions: SERGIO regulators and master regulators are the simulated transcription-factor/regulator universe for GRN inference benchmarks.
limitations: The TF list reflects the synthetic SERGIO regulatory input, not an external organism-specific TF catalogue.

scrna_global.notes: The global profile exports a single-cell expression matrix without public group labels. SERGIO may internally simulate multiple bins even for this profile, but only context=global truth is public.

upstream_configuration: Wrapper calls sim.build_graph(input_file_taregts=..., input_file_regs=..., shared_coop_state=...) before steady-state or differentiation simulation.
SERGIO uses one fixed target-interaction GRN across all simulated bins; master-regulator rates vary by bin through input_file_regs.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper parses the SERGIO target interaction rows and writes one non-self-loop regulator-target row per signed K value as context=global in truth/networks.csv.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is abs(K), where K is SERGIO's signed maximum interaction strength; public sign is '+' for K>0 and '-' for K<0.
limitations: The global truth is the fixed simulator GRN used for every bin.
SERGIO bin-specific expression differences arise from master-regulator rates and stochastic dynamics, not from different bin-specific GRN topology.

upstream_configuration: number_bins must be at least 2 for scrna_grouped.
SERGIO returns expression arrays ordered by bin; the wrapper preserves this order and assigns each column to its originating bin.
truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper derives groups.tsv from SERGIO bin membership, then duplicates the fixed SERGIO GRN into one context=group:<group_id> network for every exported group.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: Group truth uses the same score=abs(K), public sign '+' for K>0 and public sign '-' for K<0 as global truth because SERGIO does not change target-interaction K values by bin.
limitations: Group truth is an ANDREA-derived context expansion, not a native SERGIO group-specific GRN output.
All group networks have identical topology and edge parameters; this documents SERGIO's fixed-GRN design rather than dynamic group-specific regulation.

derivations.method: Assign each expression column to the SERGIO bin that produced it. Public group identifiers are bin_<zero_based_bin_id> and cell identifiers are cell_bin<bin_id>_<within_bin_index>.
assumptions: SERGIO returns expression arrays in bin-major order, and README states that concatenated columns are grouped by cell type/bin.
limitations: Groups are simulator bins/cell types, not data-driven clusters.

derivations.method: Reuse each cell's bin group as its phenotype label. For differentiation runs, assign phenotype order from topological order in the bifurcation matrix; for steady-state runs, assign numeric bin order.
assumptions: SERGIO bins correspond to intended cell types or differentiation states.
limitations: Steady-state bins have no lineage ordering beyond their numeric bin IDs.
Differentiation ordering is branch-level and does not recover individual sampled simulation times.

derivations.method: Export one row per SERGIO bin, using the public bin_<id> group as both cluster and annotation, with order from bifurcation topological order for differentiation runs or numeric bin order for steady-state runs.
assumptions: SERGIO bin identifiers are meaningful synthetic cell-type or state annotations.
limitations: Annotations are synthetic bin labels rather than curated biological cell-type names.

derivations.method: Export every public gene identifier present in expression.tsv as extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The simulated expression gene set is the appropriate enrichment background for downstream analyses of the generated dataset.
limitations: The background is dataset-derived and synthetic, not an organism-specific external annotation universe.

derivations.method: For differentiation runs, convert every non-zero bifurcation matrix entry i,j into parent=bin_i and child=bin_j. Root bins are emitted as child rows with parent='__root__', gain_rate=0 and loss_rate=0 so lineage_tree.tsv covers every group. Edge gain/loss rates are set to 0 because SERGIO uses one fixed GRN across all bins.
assumptions: SERGIO's bifurcation matrix is the intended lineage graph between simulated bins.
Because SERGIO does not change GRN topology by bin, regulatory gain/loss summaries between groups are zero under the public truth contract.
limitations: lineage_tree is unavailable for steady-state runs and is blocked unless simulation_mode=differentiation.
The artifact records bin-level lineage topology, not per-cell pseudotime or sampled transient positions.

derivations.method: Normalize every SERGIO target interaction K value into a regulator-target prior edge using score=abs(K), public sign '+' for K>0 and public sign '-' for K<0, after applying the same public gene-id mapping used for truth/networks.csv.
assumptions: The SERGIO input GRN is an oracle regulatory prior when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is a truth-derived oracle prior rather than an independently noisy prior.

derivations.method: Export the union of all regulator IDs in the target interaction file and all master-regulator IDs in the master-regulator rate file, mapped to public gene identifiers, one per line.
assumptions: SERGIO regulators and master regulators are the simulated transcription-factor/regulator universe for GRN inference benchmarks.
limitations: The TF list reflects the synthetic SERGIO regulatory input, not an external organism-specific TF catalogue.

derivations.method: For each exported group, duplicate the fixed SERGIO GRN into group-specific prior rows with group=<group_id>, score=abs(K), public sign '+' for K>0 and public sign '-' for K<0.
assumptions: SERGIO's regulatory topology and K values are fixed across bins, so the group-specific oracle prior is identical for every group.
limitations: This is a truth-derived oracle prior and does not encode group-varying regulation.
Benchmarks using prior_grn_by_group with SERGIO should account for the fact that every group prior has identical topology.

derivations.method: For every group emitted in groups.tsv, duplicate the fixed SERGIO global truth GRN into context=group:<group_id> rows in truth/networks.csv.
assumptions: A grouped benchmark can explicitly represent SERGIO's fixed-GRN design by providing one identical group context per simulated bin.
This satisfies the cumulative grouped truth contract without pretending that SERGIO models group-specific GRN changes.
limitations: Group truth networks are wrapper-derived context expansions, not native SERGIO group-specific network outputs.
All group truth contexts are identical except for their context labels.

scrna_grouped.notes: The grouped profile uses SERGIO bins as public groups. Group truth is intentionally a duplicate of the fixed global GRN for each group, because SERGIO does not model group-specific GRN topology.

input_preset.description: Selects public SERGIO input files from the pinned upstream repository or mounted custom SERGIO-format files.

simulation_mode.description: Maps to SERGIO dynamics=False for steady_state or dynamics=True plus bifurcation_matrix for differentiation.

number_genes.description: Total number of genes in the SERGIO GRN; must match the selected bundled or custom input files.

number_bins.description: Number of SERGIO cell types/bins; must match the selected master-regulator and differentiation input files.

number_sc.description: Number of single cells sampled per SERGIO bin.

noise_params.description: SERGIO noise amplitude parameter q for steady-state expression or unspliced transcripts. A scalar applies to all genes; an array provides one value per gene.

oneOf.description: Per-gene SERGIO noise amplitudes; wrapper must require length number_genes.

noise_type.description: SERGIO stochastic-noise model for steady-state expression or unspliced transcripts.

decays.description: SERGIO decay parameter. A scalar applies to all genes; an array provides one value per gene.

oneOf.description: Per-gene SERGIO decay parameters; wrapper must require length number_genes.

sampling_state.description: SERGIO sampling_state controlling how many post-steady-state time steps are simulated before sampling cells.

tol.description: SERGIO convergence tolerance used by the simulator.

window_length.description: SERGIO convergence window length in simulator time steps.

dt.description: SERGIO integration time step for steady-state simulations and unspliced dynamics.

optimize_sampling.description: Maps to SERGIO optimize_sampling; when true SERGIO may reduce sampling_state for large graphs.

shared_coop_state.description: Passed to sim.build_graph(shared_coop_state=...). Values greater than zero override per-edge Hill coefficients in the target interaction file.

noise_params_splice.description: SERGIO spliced-transcript noise parameter for differentiation mode. Null delegates to noise_params.

oneOf.description: Per-gene spliced-transcript noise amplitudes; wrapper must require length number_genes.

noise_type_splice.description: SERGIO spliced-transcript stochastic-noise model for differentiation mode. Null delegates to noise_type.

splice_ratio.description: Ratio of expected spliced to unspliced expression in differentiation simulations. A scalar applies to all genes; an array provides one value per gene.

oneOf.description: Per-gene splice ratios; wrapper must require length number_genes.

dt_splice.description: SERGIO integration time step for spliced-transcript dynamics.

differentiation_expression.description: For differentiation mode, selects whether expression.tsv uses U+S total expression, spliced expression only or unspliced expression only.

technical_noise.description: Serializable SERGIO technical-noise module controls. Enabled modules run in outlier, library-size, dropout, then UMI-conversion order.

outlier_enabled.description: Whether to apply SERGIO outlier_effect or outlier_effect_dynamics.

outlier_prob.description: Probability that a gene is selected as an outlier gene.

outlier_mean.description: Mean parameter for SERGIO outlier log-normal factors.

outlier_scale.description: Scale parameter for SERGIO outlier log-normal factors.

library_size_enabled.description: Whether to apply SERGIO lib_size_effect or lib_size_effect_dynamics.

library_size_mean.description: Mean parameter for SERGIO library-size log-normal factors.

library_size_scale.description: Scale parameter for SERGIO library-size log-normal factors.

dropout_enabled.description: Whether to apply SERGIO dropout_indicator or dropout_indicator_dynamics.

dropout_shape.description: Shape parameter for SERGIO's logistic dropout probability.

dropout_percentile.description: Percentile used as the logistic dropout midpoint.

convert_to_umi.description: Whether to convert the current expression matrix to Poisson-sampled UMI counts.

notes: Phase 3 verified. The Docker image installs SERGIO from the public GitHub repository pinned to a6190b74425112834c8fa9b4b6157d9cb3d1ab88; the wrapper calls the public Python API and emits the normalized ANDREA output package documented in profile_capabilities.
